contract: The visible result is the evidence; a state accessor is used only when the page exposes one.

steps.name: loads with no page or console error, in its starting state
steps.expect: errors.length === 0 && JSON.stringify(dom.visible) === "[\"Panels\",\"toggle alpha\",\"toggle beta\",\"alpha content\",\"beta content\"]"

steps.name: click #toggle-a produces the result it already produces
click #toggle-b produces the result it already produces
pressing 0 returns the visible result to its starting state
pressing 0 again leaves it at the starting state
no page or console error was raised at any point
